checks.name: created_at ordering soundness
checks.detail: created_at DEFAULT now() = transaction start. The assertions only slice across SEQUENTIAL awaited business transactions (tx N+1 BEGINs after tx N COMMIT returns), so now() is strictly later at microsecond resolution; a tie needs a wall-clock step back or two transactions starting in the same microsecond, neither realistic with several round-trips between them. Rows inside one transaction share now() and tie, broken by random uuid id, but every assertion within a slice is order-insensitive (every/Set/find/filter count).
